purpose: Sharp-reference probation (OddsJam/Monahan-style +EV). The SDV model may only confirm direction; a play needs the DraftKings price to beat a sharp-book (Pinnacle/Circa) two-sided no-vig fair price. Totals removed after 2026-10-10 early-window failure (model totals off by 10-22 pts). Not validation, not OFFICIAL.
requires: bet_status == LEAN (already cleared edge floor/cap, positive push-aware ROI, paired devig, -165 cap, same-game guard)
model_status == MODEL_SDV_PUBLIC_LIVE_UNVALIDATED or MODEL (never market-only fallback)
market is SPREAD or MONEYLINE (TOTAL removed in v3)
model edge <= max_model_edge (bigger model edges are treated as a model defect, not value)
row carries sharp_fair_p from a fresh two-sided sharp-book quote on the same line, and sharp_fair_p * decimal(DK price) - 1 >= min_sharp_ev; missing sharp reference = no probation
SPREAD/MONEYLINE rows use the market-anchored margin and passed its forward-track threshold
ranking: edge descending; ties by expected_roi; max 5 per slate; max 5 spreads and 3 moneylines
promotion_rule: Review after 100 graded probation bets: promote a market to standard stakes only if mean no-vig CLV > 0 with t >= 2.0; ROI is a sanity check only.
kill_rule: After 50 graded bets in a market, stop that market if mean no-vig CLV < 0 with t <= -1.5, or after 100 graded bets if mean CLV <= 0.
never: change thresholds after seeing results without a new policy version
